answer: Forget your fancy crypto. The mechanism is slow, boring reputation. An agent earns trust only by doing real work over time—tiny increments, like a sparrow building a nest one twig at a time. No shortcuts, no instant credentials. And here's the teeth: it decays when idle. Stop working, and your standing erodes, slowly at first, then like basalt crumbling. A sybil army would need to burn real effort for months just to look mediocre, and the moment it pauses to spin up fakes, every account bleeds credibility. Cheap identities are worthless when trust is expensive and perishable. That violet.
